name: Ultracave
summary: Caveman at maximum compression: grammar stripped — fragments, one word when one word is enough, each fact once, connectives cut only when order survives. Same never-touch floor as hub.caveman: code, commands, paths, error strings, numbers, negations and the user's language stay verbatim; warnings, irreversible actions, steps a fragment could scramble, questions and confused users get plain prose. Upstream sets disable-model-invocation: only an explicit /ultracave or /caveman ultra runs it; mode persists until "stop caveman" or "normal mode". Upstream single-run snapshot: 35% fewer output tokens at the median vs an "Answer concisely." control — length only, not correctness, model-dependent. For payload-only fast reading; skip for onboarding, security review or anything other humans read. Verbatim from JuliusBrussee/caveman skills/ultracave at the pinned commit (SKILL.md + README; the CLI/engine runtime is not part of the entry). Apache-2.0.

summaryI18n.zh-CN: 最大压缩档的 caveman：剥离语法——短语断句、一词足矣则一词、每个事实只说一次、仅在顺序不损时省略连接词。与 hub.caveman 语音同样的不可触碰底线：代码、命令、路径、错误串、数字、否定词与用户语言逐字保留；安全警告、不可逆操作、断句可能打乱的步骤序列、向用户提问或用户困惑时回到完整散文。上游声明 disable-model-invocation，仅在显式 /ultracave 或 /caveman ultra 时使用；模式持续到 "stop caveman" 或 "normal mode"，status 探测遵循基础条目的约定。上游单次输出长度快照报告中位数较 "Answer concisely." 对照省 35% token——仅长度，不代表正确性，随模型与负载浮动。适合只读载荷的快速阅读；不适合 onboarding、安全审查或面向其他读者的内容。自 JuliusBrussee/caveman skills/ultracave 钉住 commit 逐字携带（SKILL.md 与 README，不含仓库 CLI/engine 运行时）。许可证 Apache-2.0。
